processing: Unmodified source bytes cached locally. Shader performs spherical projection, illustrative lighting, exposure/ocean color enhancement, atmospheric tint, and local contrast/brightness thresholds to retain point sources from the catalogue star-map image while suppressing diffuse Milky Way light. It does not represent current weather, current night lights, or astronomically current illumination.

assets.sourceDateNote: Historical composite: months of land/ocean observations and several days of cloud imagery, not one observation or current weather. Collection release 2002-02-08; explanatory NASA article 2002-05-26.
